query: I have a 60-year-old man post–cardiac arrest in the ICU. Among male ICU patients 55–65 with post-arrest, what percentile is a first‑24h vital‑sign instability score of 70? Also report mean ICU LOS and mortality for the most unstable decile.
final_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instability WHERE instability_score > 1.5)::FLOAT / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM most_unstable), 0) AS percentile_rank, (SELECT avg_los FROM icu_los) AS avg_length_of_stay, (SELECT avg_mortality FROM mortality) AS avg_mortality_rate FROM instability;
